category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, test softer masked-item cross-entropy logits by increasing temperature from 0.8 to 1.0. Retain uniform target weighting, zero label smoothing, and the existing single-model architecture and inference scores; checkpoint and predictor changes are unnecessary.

change_summary: Change only masked-item cross-entropy temperature from 0.8 to 1.0 for all four category models.
